timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Let's discuss your strategy.
Who knows the strategy of Phase 1 and Phase 2?
So when it came to Phase 1, Williams, I planned out
that I wasn't really going to try and maximize my score
when it came to quantity reasoning.
Because they were not my areas of core competence.
And I'll define that on the get-go.
So my strategy, my anchor was solely focused towards
general awareness.
That's what I did.
So there are three kinds of aspirants in my mindset.
Folks that do general awareness on a daily basis,
others that do it on a weekly basis,
and those that don't on a monthly basis,
I fell in the first category.
So what I did is, I think the key differential here
for me as an aspirant is that I decided
to do general awareness by a spotlight
that I received from one of the general on a daily basis.
So I would get around 50 to 20 pages of that document.
So what I would do is I would read that document.
And I would make copy paste.
Whatever I thought was absolutely relevant on MSWord.
So that way, I would condense that 50 to 20 page document
into RIT 1 or 2 pages on that MSWord file.
